title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. I am registered pharmacist according to Maharashtra pharmacy council 2919 views Q. Eating Rabbit 7981 views Q. I am a PhD Student in a reputed research institute from India. The sole niyyat of my doing PhD is daawat/tashkeel/kasb-e-halaal in the institute. Once in 6 months I need to go in a conference and present a paper in a conference hall or auditorium. I have a beard with fist length and I am always in long loose kurta and shalwar above ankles. When I am on the stage, the photographers treat me similar to all the audience and take a photo/video of mine or they take my photo whenever I ask questions during the discussion. They do this for non-muslims too. I totally dislike that someone take my photo, because thats haraam as per my knowledge. So my respected muftyaan-e-ikraam is it permissible for a practising muslim to wear a thin helmet (with face cover) and goto such places? If the audience laugh seeing a practising Muslim in helmet, is then wearing the helmet permissible in shariat? I feel my niyaat of daawat/tashkeel and my muaamlaat demand that I should go there but shariat prohibits photography so how shall I maintain taqwa in this issue? Is the question clear ? Hoping for an earliest reply. 2390 views Q. Is it permissible to keep Hamsters as pets? If not please give reason? 8100 views Q. My question is that I am having very serious problem know about masturbation, I want to know that is masturbation totally haram in Islam and in all Fiqh 3324 views Q. Can we eat broiler chicken or egg? Is it halal or haram? Please give reply as soon as possible. 5329 views Q. How to get rid of masturbation? 5307 views Q. Allah has made me a software engineer by profession.Currently working in a reputed software company in India. I want to leave this company and start my own work as I do not feel my Iman each time so strong that I may be able to violate the cultures of the company which are not according to sharia like wearing pent shirt, Answering greetings of Na Maharam.Also things like the mendatory insurance component in the salary which I do not want to subscribe for, still deducted from my salary. In short these and some other things inspire me to start my own job.My parents have taken loan from bank.The loan includes interest terms also..Allah helps them to repay the loan via me.(However I am not the only source but Allah has made me as a major contributor towards repayment of the loan). Is this okay If I ask My parents to give me few months (2-3) to collect money by the salary instead of giving them and made investment in new work? However I have talked already to my parents about it that this new work may require some investment of a good portion of 2-3 months salary and they have given there consent. So the first question is what is better?Should I continue to work in the company and made small investments towards the own work (Which I feel a long process). Or go with the instant investment by putting the portion of salary towards new job which Allah gives currently to my parents via me.Ofcaurse success will be there only if Allah wills. My second question is regarding the new work I wants to start. InshaAllah it will be website based work initially. The plan is to provide a internet based facility to people where people can learn by there and other people's learnings. Learning means any learning what people may put on the website.Hence this learning can be according to sharia and opposite to sharia also. Like one people my place his/her learning as "Speak truth even in tough situation" and another one may place his learning as "Alcohol is good for health".So people may read both wrong and right learnings also.In addition the learnings can be of any other type also like business learning etc. Its like an opinion of someone by his/her experience. So the second question is such service/website allowed. The third question is about charging the people who use this service. Someone may be allowed to pay amount(as a fees of using this website) if He/She feels that he/she has benefitted via this website. So its upto that "Somebody" whether he wants to pay for the use website or not. Is such earning halal,(Please let me know even if its halal but undesirable)? Also should I set a maximum amount which a person can pay if he/she wills to pay? Please consider the use of this website for business organizations also where it becomes obligatory chargable. 3091 views Q. اقتصادیات سے متعلق اکثر مضامین میں سودی طریقے سکھائے جاتے ہیں، تو کیاا قتصادیات کے مضامین (جیسے بونڈ، اسٹاک، سود کے ساتھ)اکاؤنٹنگ(حساب و کتاب) پڑھا نا جائزہے؟اور کیا ایسے مضامین پڑھا کر حاصل ہونے والی آمدنی حلال ہے یا نہیں؟ 1352 views Q. answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 33406 Country: India Title: Circumcision (Katnah)by non-Muslim doctor? Question: Whether Circumcision (Khatnah) can be performed by a non-Muslim doctor? Answer ID: 33406 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1219/1219/M=1432) One can get circumcision done by a non-Muslim doctor as well. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
